_comment: respond / Respond / job_respond as the four SDKs must answer it. Each case is a run, as the platform's run JSON the SDK builds its own run from (a JobRun in Go, Node and Python, a toft_run in R), or — where a language's respond takes anything — a bare string standing in for one. The run start() returned answers 202 with Location = its status_url, or 303 there when Accept names text/html; every other case is bad_request with a hint and nothing written. Read beside the storage vector, by the same four runners: sdk/go/storage_env_vector_test.go, sdk/node/test/storage-env-vector.test.js, sdk/python/tests/test_storage_env_vector.py and, for R, sdk/storage_env_vector_r_test.go. Go's Respond is typed, so it skips the string case.
